changeSet.author: sydorenko
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO lesson_completion (enrollment_id, lesson_id, completed_at) SELECT e.id, l.id, GETDATE() FROM enrollment e INNER JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id INNER JOIN module m ON c.id = m.course_id INNER JOIN lesson l ON m.id = l.module_id WHERE m.order_index BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND e.user_id IN (SELECT top 100 id FROM [user] WHERE username LIKE 'student_%');

rollback.sql: DELETE lc FROM lesson_completion lc INNER JOIN enrollment e ON lc.enrollment_id = e.id INNER JOIN [user] u ON e.user_id = u.id WHERE u.username LIKE 'student_%';
